tagline: Independent Investigative Journalism & Long-Form Global Reporting
primary_audience: Informed readers, policy analysts, investigative researchers, and public interest advocates

aesthetic_direction.typography: Classic high-legibility editorial serif (e.g. Merriweather or Source Serif Pro) for body copy with punchy headline display serif (e.g. Frank Ruhl Libre or Playfair)
aesthetic_direction.composition: Multi-column broadsheet-inspired editorial grid, varying lead story hierarchy, prominent bylines and reading time, pull-quote callouts, and clean article reader mode

media_guidelines: Photojournalism with authentic source captions, historical archival imagery, and clear informational data charts. Strict credit provenance.
anti_patterns: Clickbait layout patterns with screaming badges
Identical card dimensions for lead story vs minor brief
